title: Food and drink
about: Everyday food (bread, rice, meat, fish), fast food, fruit and vegetables, and drinks like tea, milk and juice. Also which food words have no plural: bread, rice, fruit, milk.

parts.title: Common mistakes
parts.note: Багато назв їжі англійською незлічувані: bread, rice, pasta, meat, fish, salt, sugar, fruit, garlic, milk, tea, coffee, water. З ними не ставлять a/an і зазвичай не додають -s: some bread, a slice of bread, a glass of milk. А більшість овочів і фруктів злічувані: a carrot, two carrots, an apple. Українські збірні слова (картопля, морква, цибуля, полуниця, виноград) англійською зазвичай у множині: potatoes, carrots, onions, strawberries, grapes. У кафе можна сказати a coffee, two teas — це «чашка кави», «два чаї». І пастка: у Британії chips — це картопля фрі, а чипси з пачки — crisps.

items.pattern: bread (no plural) · some bread · a slice / a loaf of bread
items.meaning: a basic food made from flour and water and baked; you make sandwiches with it
items.example: Can you buy some **bread** on your way home?
more: I like warm **bread** with butter.
There's no **bread** left. Let's have rice.
items.watchOut: Bread — незлічуване: some bread, a slice of bread (скибка), a loaf of bread (буханець). Не a bread і не breads.

items.pattern: rice (no plural) · some rice · a bowl of rice
items.meaning: small white or brown grains that you cook in water
items.example: We're having chicken and **rice** for dinner tonight.
more: My grandma makes **rice** pudding with milk and sugar.
There's a big bag of **rice** in the cupboard.
items.watchOut: Rice — незлічуване: some rice, a bowl of rice. Не rices.

items.pattern: pasta (no plural) · cook pasta · pasta with sauce
items.meaning: Italian food made from flour and water, for example spaghetti
items.example: My dad makes great **pasta** with tomato sauce.
more: Do you want **pasta** or pizza for lunch?
We bought three kinds of **pasta** in Italy.
items.watchOut: Усі «макарони» (спагеті, ріжки, мушлі) англійською — pasta. Macaroni — тільки короткі трубочки. Pasta незлічуване: some pasta, не pastas.

items.pattern: salt · put salt on / in sth · salt and pepper
items.meaning: white stuff from the sea that gives food more taste
items.example: This soup needs a little more **salt**.
more: Don't put too much **salt** on your food.
Can you pass the **salt**, please?

items.pattern: pepper · black pepper · salt and pepper
items.meaning: a black or white powder with a hot taste that you put on food
items.example: I like a lot of black **pepper** on my eggs.
more: **Pepper** makes food a little hot.
Can I have some **pepper** for my pasta?
items.watchOut: Pepper — і мелений перець (спеція), і овоч: a red / green pepper (солодкий перець). Кажуть salt and pepper — саме в такому порядку.

items.pattern: chips (plural) · fish and chips · burger and chips
items.meaning: long pieces of potato cooked in hot oil
items.example: Can I have a burger and **chips**, please?
more: The kids want **chips** with everything!
These **chips** are too hot to eat.
items.watchOut: Пастка! У британській англійській chips — картопля фрі (американці кажуть fries). Українські «чипси» з пачки британською — crisps, а американською — chips.

items.pattern: meat (no plural) · eat meat · some meat
items.meaning: food from animals, for example chicken or beef
items.example: Grandma cooks **meat** and potatoes every Sunday.
more: Keep the **meat** in the fridge.
Our dog loves **meat**, but our cat prefers fish.
items.watchOut: Meat і meet (зустрічати) звучать однаково: /miːt/. Meat незлічуване: some meat, не a meat.

items.pattern: fish (as food, no plural) · eat fish · three fish
items.meaning: an animal that lives in water; also its meat as food
items.example: We eat **fish** twice a week.
more: My cat waits by the door when I cook **fish**.
Is this **fish** from the sea or from a river?
items.watchOut: Як їжа fish незлічуване: I like fish, some fish. Множина від fish зазвичай теж fish: I caught three fish.

items.pattern: be (a) vegetarian · vegetarian food
items.meaning: a person who doesn't eat meat or fish; food without meat or fish
items.example: Is there a **vegetarian** pizza on the menu?
more: Are you **vegetarian**? Then try the bean soup.
We cooked **vegetarian** food for the party: pasta and vegetables.
items.watchOut: Наголос на третьому складі: vege-TA-rian. Можна сказати і She's vegetarian, і She's a vegetarian.

items.pattern: sugar · take sugar in tea / coffee
items.meaning: sweet white or brown stuff you put in drinks and cakes
items.example: I don't take **sugar** in my tea.
more: Dad puts two spoons of **sugar** in his coffee.
Too much **sugar** is bad for your teeth.
items.watchOut: Do you take sugar? — «Ти п'єш із цукром?» Тут take = додавати собі. Вимова: перший звук — «ш»: /ˈʃʊɡə/.

items.pattern: a hamburger · hamburgers · (short) a burger
items.meaning: meat in a round flat shape, inside a round bread roll
items.example: I'd like a **hamburger** and a glass of juice, please.
more: We made **hamburgers** in the garden on Saturday.
This café sells the best **hamburgers** in town.
items.watchOut: Часто кажуть коротко: a burger. З сиром — a cheeseburger.

items.pattern: a hot dog · hot dogs
items.meaning: a long sausage inside a long bread roll
items.example: We bought **hot dogs** at the football match.
more: Do you want ketchup on your **hot dog**?
My little cousin ate two **hot dogs**!

items.pattern: a pizza · pizzas · a slice of pizza
items.meaning: flat round bread with tomato, cheese and other food on top
items.example: Let's order a **pizza** tonight.
more: I'd like a slice of cheese **pizza**, please.
We made our own **pizza** at home.
items.watchOut: Ціла піца — a pizza, дві — two pizzas. Шматок — a slice / a piece of pizza.

items.pattern: fish and chips (+ is) · a fish and chips shop
items.meaning: fish fried in hot oil, with chips; a famous British meal
items.example: We had **fish and chips** by the sea.
more: **Fish and chips** is my dad's favourite meal.
There's a good **fish and chips** shop near the station.
items.watchOut: Порядок слів сталий: fish and chips, не chips and fish. Це одна страва, тому часто кажуть Fish and chips is …

items.pattern: fruit (usually no plural) · eat fruit · a piece of fruit
items.meaning: apples, bananas, oranges, grapes and so on
items.example: I eat a lot of **fruit** in summer.
more: Shall we buy some **fruit** at the market?
My grandad sells **fruit** and vegetables.
items.watchOut: Українське «фрукти» — множина, а fruit зазвичай незлічуване: I love fruit, fruit is good for you. Не I love fruits. Вимова /fruːt/ — без «і».

items.pattern: vegetables (plural) · a vegetable
items.meaning: plants we eat, for example carrots, potatoes and onions
items.example: Eat your **vegetables**, they're good for you!
more: We grow **vegetables** in our garden.
Grandma makes soup with lots of **vegetables**.
items.watchOut: Вимова: три склади, «ВЕДЖ-те-блз», друге e не читається. Vegetables — злічуване, у множині (а fruit — ні).

items.pattern: a carrot · carrots
items.meaning: a long orange vegetable
items.example: Rabbits love **carrots**.
more: I put two **carrots** in the soup.
Mum gave the horse a **carrot**.
items.watchOut: «Морква» — збірне слово, а англійською рахують штуки: a carrot, two carrots, I like carrots.

items.pattern: beans · green beans · a bean
items.meaning: long thin green vegetables, or the seeds inside them
items.example: We're having fish with green **beans**.
more: I don't like **beans**, but I like peas.
In Britain people often eat **beans** on toast.
items.watchOut: Green beans — стручкова квасоля, beans — квасоля, а в Британії часто ще й квасоля в томатному соусі (baked beans).

items.pattern: a potato · potatoes
items.meaning: a round vegetable that grows under the ground; you make chips from it
items.example: Can you peel the **potatoes**, please?
more: I'd like fish with boiled **potatoes**, please.
Grandad grows **potatoes** in his garden.
items.watchOut: «Картопля» — збірне, а англійською: a potato, two potatoes (множина з -es). Картопляне пюре — mashed potatoes.

items.pattern: a tomato · tomatoes
items.meaning: a soft round red vegetable, often in salads
items.example: I'm making a salad with **tomatoes** and cheese.
more: Pizza has **tomato** sauce on it.
We grow **tomatoes** on the balcony.
items.watchOut: Множина з -es: tomatoes. Британська вимова — «томАтоу», американська — «томЕйтоу».

items.pattern: peas · a pea · frozen peas
items.meaning: very small round green vegetables
items.example: My little sister doesn't like **peas**.
more: I've got frozen **peas** in the freezer.
Put some **peas** and carrots in the rice.
items.watchOut: Pea /piː/ — одна горошина, зазвичай кажуть peas. Не плутай з pear /peə/ — груша.

items.pattern: an onion · onions
items.meaning: a round vegetable with a brown skin and a strong smell
items.example: Fry the **onions** until they're soft and brown.
more: Cutting **onions** always makes me cry.
Do you want **onions** on your hot dog?
items.watchOut: Вимова: перший звук як у fun — «АН'єн», не «о». «Цибуля» — збірне; англійською an onion, two onions.

items.pattern: garlic (no plural) · a clove of garlic
items.meaning: a small white vegetable like an onion, with a very strong taste
items.example: This pasta has a lot of **garlic** in it.
more: I can smell **garlic** from the kitchen.
Put some **garlic** in the soup.
items.watchOut: Garlic — незлічуване: some garlic, a clove of garlic (зубчик). Не garlics.

items.pattern: a mushroom · mushrooms
items.meaning: a small white or brown plant with a round top that people eat
items.example: I'd like a pizza with **mushrooms**, please.
more: Fry the **mushrooms** with a little garlic.
My sister picks the **mushrooms** off her pizza.

items.pattern: an orange · oranges · orange juice
items.meaning: a round fruit with a thick orange skin and a lot of juice
items.example: I have an **orange** in my school bag.
more: Can you peel this **orange** for me?
I drink **orange** juice every morning.
items.watchOut: Вимова: «ОРиндж», наголос на першому складі. Перед orange — an: an orange. Orange — ще й колір (помаранчевий).

items.pattern: an apple · apples · apple juice
items.meaning: a round red, green or yellow fruit that grows on trees
items.example: Take an **apple** for your break.
more: Grandma is making an **apple** pie.
I've got an **apple** and a sandwich for lunch.
items.watchOut: Перед apple — an: an apple. Не a apple.

items.pattern: a banana · bananas
items.meaning: a long, curved yellow fruit
items.example: I eat a **banana** before football practice.
more: Can I have a **banana** milkshake, please?
There are three **bananas** in the fruit bowl.
items.watchOut: Британська вимова — «бенАна», наголос на другому складі.

items.pattern: a pear · pears
items.meaning: a green or yellow fruit, round at the bottom and thinner at the top
items.example: Would you like an apple or a **pear**?
more: There's a **pear** tree behind the school.
**Pears** are soft when they're ready to eat.
items.watchOut: Вимова /peə/ — як pair (пара) і wear. Не «пір». Не плутай з peas (горошок).

items.pattern: grapes · a bunch of grapes · a grape
items.meaning: small round green or purple fruit that grow together in a bunch
items.example: These green **grapes** are very sweet.
more: Wash the **grapes** before you eat them.
Grandad grows **grapes** in his garden.
items.watchOut: «Виноград» — однина, а англійською grapes — множина: The grapes are sweet. Одна ягідка — a grape.

items.pattern: a strawberry · strawberries
items.meaning: a small, soft red summer fruit
items.example: In June we pick **strawberries** at the farm.
more: Grandma makes **strawberry** jam every summer.
These **strawberries** are big and red.
items.watchOut: «Полуниця» часто збірне, а англійською — множина: I love strawberries. Вимова — «СТРОбриз».

items.pattern: a pineapple · pineapple juice
items.meaning: a big fruit from hot countries, yellow inside, with a hard skin and green leaves on top
items.example: Can you cut the **pineapple** into small pieces?
more: A fresh **pineapple** is quite heavy.
**Pineapple** is sweet and a little sour.
items.watchOut: Ананас англійською — pineapple, не ananas. Пишеться разом: pine + apple.

items.pattern: tea · a cup of tea · tea with milk / lemon
items.meaning: a hot drink made with water and dry leaves
items.example: Would you like a cup of **tea**?
more: In Britain people often drink **tea** with milk.
We drink **tea** with cake at Grandma's.
items.watchOut: Міцний чай — strong tea, не hard tea. «Пити чай» — drink tea або have a cup of tea.

items.pattern: coffee · a cup of coffee · black / white coffee
items.meaning: a hot brown drink; many adults drink it in the morning
items.example: Mum can't start the day without a cup of **coffee**.
more: My parents drink **coffee**, but I drink juice.
The **coffee** is too hot. Wait a minute.
items.watchOut: Кава з молоком — white coffee або coffee with milk, чорна — black coffee. Наголос на першому складі: «КОфі».

items.pattern: milk (no plural) · a glass / a bottle of milk
items.meaning: a white drink that comes from cows
items.example: I drink a glass of **milk** before bed.
more: We need to buy **milk**. There's none left.
Do you take **milk** in your tea?
items.watchOut: Milk незлічуване: some milk, a glass of milk. Не milks.

items.pattern: fruit juice · orange / apple juice · a glass of juice
items.meaning: a drink made from fruit
items.example: Can I have a glass of **fruit juice**, please?
more: **Fruit juice** has a lot of sugar in it.
We had pancakes and **fruit juice** for breakfast.
items.watchOut: Juice вимовляється «джус». Конкретний сік — просто назва фрукта перед juice: orange juice, apple juice.

items.pattern: mineral water · a bottle of mineral water · still / sparkling
items.meaning: water from under the ground that you buy in bottles
items.example: It's hot today. Take a bottle of **mineral water** with you.
more: Is this **mineral water** sparkling? I like the bubbles.
There are ten bottles of **mineral water** in the car.
items.watchOut: Газована — sparkling, негазована — still. Наголос у mineral на першому складі: «МІнерел».

items.pattern: beer · a glass of beer
items.meaning: an alcoholic drink for adults, made from grain
items.example: My uncle sometimes has a glass of **beer** with his dinner.
more: Germany is famous for its **beer**.
My aunt doesn't drink **beer**. She prefers tea.
items.watchOut: Вимова /bɪə/ — «біа». Не плутай з bear /beə/ — ведмідь.

items.pattern: wine · red / white wine · a glass of wine
items.meaning: an alcoholic drink for adults, made from grapes
items.example: My parents had a glass of **wine** at the wedding.
more: There's a bottle of red **wine** on the table.
Italy is famous for its **wine** and its pasta.
items.watchOut: Червоне вино — red wine, біле — white wine.

warmup.explain: Bread — незлічуване, тому some bread або a slice of bread. Не a bread.
Fruit зазвичай незлічуване, без -s: I love fruit.

warmup.uk: Мій друг Макс не їсть м'яса. Він вегетаріанець.
warmup.q: My friend Max doesn't eat meat. He's ___.
warmup.explain: Людина, що не їсть м'яса й риби, — vegetarian. Vegetable — овоч.

warmup.uk: Мені рибу з картоплею фрі, будь ласка.
warmup.explain: Картопля фрі у Британії — chips. Crisps — чипси з пачки.

warmup.q: Do you ___ sugar in your tea?
warmup.explain: Про цукор чи молоко в чаї кажуть take: Do you take sugar?
Grapes — множина, тому these і are.
Міцний чай чи кава — strong. Hard і heavy тут не кажуть.
Ананас — pineapple: pine + apple, разом і з e посередині.

A.q: Sea water has a lot of ___ in it.
A.explain: Морська вода солона — у ній багато солі, salt.

A.q: I buy a loaf of ___ at the baker's.
A.explain: A loaf of bread — буханець хліба.

A.q: Can you pass me the salt and ___, please?
A.explain: Сіль і перець — salt and pepper, саме в такому порядку.

B.q: A ___ is long, but a hamburger is round.
B.explain: Hot dog — довга булочка з сосискою. Піца кругла.

B.q: The ___ was round and flat, with cheese and tomato on top.
B.explain: Кругла пласка основа з сиром і томатом — pizza.

B.q: Which is a famous British meal: ___?
B.explain: Кажуть тільки fish and chips — риба з картоплею фрі.

C.q: This vegetable has a strong smell and a brown skin. It's an ___.
C.explain: Цибуля — onion. Orange і apple — фрукти, не овочі.

C.q: This long yellow fruit is a ___.
___ grow under the ground. We make chips from them.
C.explain: Картопля росте в землі, з неї роблять chips. Множина — potatoes.

D.q: Do you drink your ___ black or with milk?
D.explain: Чорна кава — black coffee, з молоком — white coffee.

D.q: This drink is made from oranges. It's fruit ___.
D.explain: Сік — juice: fruit juice, orange juice.

example.title: Saturday at the market
example.uk:
У суботу ми з мамою пішли на ринок. Ми купили хліб, картоплю, моркву й цибулю для супу. Я хотіла полуниці, але вона була дуже дорога, тож ми купили банани й виноград.

Потім ми зголодніли й пішли в кафе. Мама випила каву, а я — склянку фруктового соку. Ми розділили на двох велику піцу з грибами.

Удома мама зварила суп. Я додала трохи солі й перцю. Суп був дуже смачний, і тато попросив ще!
example.en:
On Saturday Mum and I went to the market. We bought [[bread|a1]], [[potatoes|c5]], [[carrots|c3]] and [[onions|c8]] for soup. I wanted [[strawberries|c16]], but they were very expensive, so we bought [[bananas|c13]] and [[grapes|c15]].

Then we were hungry, so we went to a café. Mum had a [[coffee|d2]] and I had a glass of [[fruit juice|d4]]. We shared a big [[pizza|b3]] with [[mushrooms|c10]].

At home Mum made the soup. I put in a little [[salt|a4]] and [[pepper|a5]]. It was delicious, and Dad asked for more!
